parser.description: The parse stage. With a doc-parser sidecar configured it is unavailable (code DOCS_ENGINE_PARSER_UNAVAILABLE, 1.10) while the sidecar's /healthz fails and the engine status is degraded: pdf, docx and pptx wait, md, txt, csv and xlsx still work.

ocr_parser.description: 1.10: the ocr-parser sidecar, present only when configured; unavailable when its /healthz fails.

media_parser.description: 1.10: the media-parser sidecar, present only when configured; unavailable when its /healthz fails.

DriveConfigS3.description: Drives of backend s3, r2, oss and cos (S3 compatible), credentials as two references (1.10: valid for all four backends, not only s3). Each of access_key_id, secret_access_key and session_token is {secret_ref} and resolves to the plain value. endpoint is optional for r2, oss and cos (derived from region, or account_id for r2); region is required for oss and cos unless endpoint is given; account_id for r2 (32 hex); internal selects the in-cloud endpoint of oss and cos. Keys are never inline. DriveConfigCloud is the alternative with one secret_ref that resolves to a JSON credential.

config.description: 与 DriveCreate.config 同形；secret_ref 原样返回，从不返回密钥值

confirm_mass_delete.description: 确认被 held 的代际

paths.description: G11/D47 targeted sync: stat only these paths and parents; never advances the generation or sweeps.

Block.description: oo.doc-ir/v1 block，见 contracts/docs-ir/doc-ir.v1.schema.json#/$defs/block；另加 src 字段（出处片段）

src.description: Source mark, canonical form [src:<path>#<frag>] (spec 10 6.2): the path percent-encodes ], #, % and whitespace.
Source mark, canonical form [src:<path>#<frag>] (spec 10 6.2): the path percent-encodes ], #, % and whitespace.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency token of corrections: send as If-Match "r<revision>" to POST /facts/{id}:correct.

edit.description: decision=edit 时：fact 的 value/valid_from/valid_to，或 merge 的目标实体，或 alias 的归属实体

as_of_seq.description: 只处理该序号前入队的项，避免误收新项

vector.description: Since 1.5. Local vector model version used only to rank the 'other related' section of BRIEF (10 11.3). Omitted means the engine default (off unless the operator enabled a model). The version is part of the pack parameters: the same version replays byte for byte, another version is another pack.

target_dir.description: 仅守护进程填充，来自 mounts.json

command.description: 等价的 oo context mount 命令行（不含凭证）

Freshness.description: G12/G16, 00 §5.5. Priority held > degraded > syncing > processing > publishing > waiting_review > up_to_date.

ModelConfig.description: G3: the key value is never returned.

confirm.description: The id of the drive to rebuild. A full rebuild is manual and needs this confirmation (10 4.2, D23).

files.description: Files marked outdated; they are reprocessed at priority 900, one at a time, each new extraction judged by DOC-G10.

SuggestionRecord.description: oo.suggest/v1 (10 11.1). object and value: exactly one for the fact kinds. share_id only with the engine token (the collector); a share credential implies it.

supersedes.description: a [src:...] tag of the BRIEF or a fact_key

SuggestRequest.description: One record, or items (at most 50 records), or documents (at most 200 files read from suggest/: name, format md|json, text). Idempotent per share on idempotency_key or the content hash; no Idempotency-Key header. The single-record form carries the SuggestionRecord fields at the top level; the request is closed like every request object.

supersedes.description: a [src:...] tag of the BRIEF or a fact_key

items.description: A Suggestion, or {status: invalid, error, document?, code?} for a record or document that was refused.

SuggestionDiff.description: A draft for Desktop's revision mode; OO never writes the Drive. writable is true for an editor share; the write is Desktop's.

DrivePolicy.description: Drive access policy (10 11.3): whole-segment path prefixes. Empty allow means the whole Drive; deny always wins. Applied in ingest and in the visible graph.

DriveConfigCloud.description: Drives of backend s3, r2, oss and cos (S3 compatible), credentials as one secret_ref that resolves to the JSON {access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token?} (oo source add writes this file). DriveConfigS3 is the alternative with two references; the two shapes cannot be mixed. region is required for oss and cos unless endpoint is given; account_id for r2 (32 hex); internal selects the in-cloud endpoint of oss and cos. Keys are never inline.

messages.description: Bucket event notification bodies as the cloud's queue delivered them (S3 Records, R2 Queues message, OSS MNS or EventBridge, or the neutral {hints:[...]} form), objects or JSON text.

CloudToken.description: The oodc_ token is shown once. Valid on the cloud entry only.

AgentTokenRequest.description: Issue an Agent token (`ooa_`). `docs:*` scopes need `drive_ids` or `all_drives`; `db:read` needs `gw_profile` (the NAME of a Gateway profile the CLI proxy reads the database ontology with; never a credential) and `gw_profile` needs `db:read`. `docs:suggest` and `docs:write` need `docs:read`. One live token per name.

AgentToken.description: The `ooa_` token is shown once and only its hash is stored. Valid on the local entry only (the loopback API), checked on every route.

AgentTokenInfo.description: An Agent token as the list and `GET /agent-tokens/self` show it: never the token, never a hash. `drives` is only in the answer of `self`.

AgentIntrospect.description: Answer of `POST /agent-tokens:introspect` (control token only): always 200; `active: false` carries a `reason`. Not a use of the token.

AuditAgents.description: Calls, refusals, issues and revocations of Agent tokens, newest first. A call is a route template (values are `{id}`), never a path value or text.

provenance.description: Where a link comes from: the file anchors of the document entity (page and box, sheet and cell, heading and line; `anchor` is the document IR anchor) and the table row it is linked to with the rule that matched.

LinkList.description: `agent_db` is `unbound` when no Agent DB is configured (documents only: an empty list is the normal answer) and `bound` otherwise. An Agent token only sees the links of its Drives.

ProjectRuns.description: What the projection did per Drive: `skipped` (`no_agent_db`, `unchanged`, `no_ontology`, `drive_inactive`) or `projection` (entities inserted, rewritten because their digest changed, removed) and `links` (created, updated, removed).

LinkRuleRequest.description: Match `name_col` (and `alias_cols`) of `db_table` against document entities of `entity_type` (empty: any). One rule per (Drive, table); a changed rule moves its `revision`. Plain identifiers only; `_oo*`, `pg_catalog` and `information_schema` are refused.

AgentDbBindingRequest.description: A secret reference (`env:NAME`, `file:/absolute/path` or a name in the secrets directory) whose content is the connection URL of the Agent DB login. A URL is never accepted. The reference must resolve and the login must connect.

OntologyProvenance.description: A file anchor (`kind` file: drive_id, path, file_version, block_id, anchor) or a table row (`kind` table_row: source, table, pk, key_column, publication_id, data_vector_sha256) or a Gateway query (`kind` gateway_query).

SearchHit.description: One hit of `GET /v1/docs/search` (1.9). `kind` `fact`: a published fact whose subject name, predicate words, value text or object name matches; `kind` `block`: a block of a live file version. `score` is `ts_rank_cd(..., 32)` in [0, 1). Every hit has at least one `evidence` object (the file anchor).

id.description: The fact id, or `<file_id>#<block_id>` for a block.

text.description: Fact: the value text or the object name. Block: the block text, flattened and cut at 240 characters.

items.description: Where a hit comes from: the file, its version, the block and the anchor inside it.

SearchResult.description: Answer of `GET /v1/docs/search?q&drive_id&limit` (1.9): full text search (PostgreSQL `simple` configuration; a CJK character is one token, a Chinese phrase is a phrase match; words are prefixes; all terms must match) over facts and blocks. Order: `score` descending, then fact before block, then id. `truncated` is true when `limit` or a scan bound (300 files, 20000 blocks per file) cut the result. An `ooa_` token needs `docs:read` and a `drive_id` of its set (or all Drives).

OntologySearchResult.description: Answer of `GET /v1/ontology/search` (CLI proxy surface, 1.7): one merged result set over documents (engine) and databases (Gateway). Every item has a stable URN and a provenance; `sides` says which side answered.

kind.description: 1.9: what matched. Absent means `entity` (a name or alias, 1.7).

text.description: 1.9: the matched fact value or block text.

OntologyEntity.description: Answer of `GET /v1/ontology/entities/{urn}` (1.7): the entity with facts (each cited) or the table row, and its links to the other side (a linked row or document carries its own provenance).

OntologySources.description: Answer of `GET /v1/ontology/sources` (1.7): the Drives and the database the token reaches.

OntologyQueryRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/ontology/query` (1.7): one read-only SELECT. Anything else is 403 `ONTOLOGY_READ_ONLY`.

OntologyQueryResult.description: Answer of `POST /v1/ontology/query` (1.7), read through the Gateway profile of the token (`db:read`).

title: Super Ontology Docs Control API
description: docs-api/1.0-draft: spec 10 §8.2 with the §8.8 (G1-G3, G5-G15) and §16.10 (G16-G24) additions. Request objects are closed; response objects stay open so minor versions can add fields. Owned by the integration thread; every change carries a Contract-Version trailer (50 §6).
